text:
olivia-nguyen: Hey team — planning to move to Tokyo with my partner for ~3 months starting May 15 for their work assignment. Quick Qs: will my WFH allowance be prorated? Is health coverage still valid while I’m in Japan? Any payroll/tax steps I need to take?

maya-people-ops: @olivia-nguyen thanks for flagging — short answer: probably yes on proration, and there are a couple payroll/benefits checks. Can you confirm exact dates and whether you'll keep US homebase on file?

olivia-nguyen: Dates would be 2025-05-15 to 2025-08-15. Planning to keep my US homebase (Seattle) — temporary stay only.

maya-people-ops: Good, keeping US homebase makes things simpler. Quick overview: 1) WFH stipend: monthly stipend is $150/mo — we prorate partial months. 2) Benefits: most US plans cover emergency care abroad but not routine care; we recommend travel insurance for non-emergency. 3) Payroll/tax: short stays <183 days usually don't create nexus, but we need to record the trip and confirm no local registration required.

ben-payroll: Hi @olivia-nguyen — please submit dates to the Travel & Remote Log (https://redwood.internal/travel-log) and cc payroll. I'll check state withholding implications for Seattle -> temporary Japan stay. Also if you have any income sourced in Japan while there (unlikely) we need to know.

ryan-benefits: @olivia-nguyen our US medical plans have out-of-country emergency coverage; prescriptions and routine visits likely not covered. We can issue a one-off confirmation letter for any immigration use if needed. If you expect ongoing care, consider a short-term international plan.

olivia-nguyen: Thanks — no local income, just remote work. Do I need to change any settings in ADP or self-serve payroll?

ben-payroll: No change to homebase in ADP while it's temporary. Please make sure your address on file remains the US address. We'll log the travel window on our side. If the stay gets extended beyond ~120 days we'll re-evaluate.

maya-people-ops: Also, stipend proration example: May (partial month) -> prorated based on days in US vs abroad; June/July full months -> full stipend, August partial -> prorated. We'll compute automatically once payroll has the logged dates.

olivia-nguyen: Quick follow on WFH stipend: will I still get equipment reimbursements if needed while abroad?

maya-people-ops: Equipment reimbursements (one-time) are separate from monthly WFH allowance. If you need to buy anything for the trip (portable monitor, travel adapter) save receipts and submit via Expensify tagging expense code "equipment". Approval still required from manager.

olivia-nguyen: Got it — filing dates now. Appreciate the clarity.

legal-bot: NOTE: If travel becomes recurring or you plan to work >183 days in a foreign jurisdiction, contact Legal early — potential permanent establishment or employment law implications.

ben-payroll: @olivia-nguyen logged your dates. You'll see proration reflected on the June payroll run for May partial month. Ping me if travel dates change.

olivia-nguyen: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: will reach out if anything changes.

maya-people-ops: Filing checklist for reference: - Submit Travel & Remote Log link - Confirm homebase stays US - Save equipment receipts if needed - Travel insurance for routine care recommended - Notify manager & payroll of any extensions

olivia-nguyen: Checklist noted. One last thing — any visa paperwork Redwood can provide (employment verification)?

ryan-benefits: We can provide a benefits enrollment letter. @maya-people-ops can coordinate employment verification with People Ops.

maya-people-ops: Yep — @olivia-nguyen DM me and I'll generate an employment verification and benefits confirmation letter.
